pages.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR Compliance
pages.content:
At Metazivo Digital Agency (accessible from https://metazivo.com), we take your privacy and data protection seriously. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of information we collect, how it is processed and protected, and your statutory rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and global data privacy standards.

1. Data Controller Information

The data controller responsible for your personal data on this website is:

  • Agency: Metazivo Digital Agency
  • Principal / Founder: Mehar Ali Hassan
  • Official Contact Email: meharalihassan019@gmail.com
  • Website URL: https://metazivo.com

2. Information We Collect

We only collect personal information when there is a legitimate business or service delivery reason:

  • Contact & Consultation Forms: Name, business email, phone/WhatsApp number, website URL, and project specifications provided when requesting an SEO audit or project proposal.
  • Free Diagnostic SEO Tools Usage: URLs, domain queries, or technical inputs entered into our free utilities (e.g. Website Speed Test, Broken Link Checker, Toxic Links Checker). These inputs are processed in real-time to generate diagnostic feedback and are never sold or rented.
  • Technical Server Logs: IP address, browser type, device operating system, referring URL, and timestamps collected automatically for rate-limiting, bot attack defense, and server health.

3. How We Use Your Data

Your information is used strictly for legitimate operational purposes:

  • To deliver digital marketing, technical SEO, AEO/GEO, web engineering, and advertising services.
  • To respond to your inquiries, schedule technical consultations, and send requested project quotes.
  • To maintain, protect, and optimize the security and performance of our web infrastructure.
  • We operate a strict Zero-Sale Policy: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties, data aggregators, or advertising brokers.

4. Cookies & Analytical Technologies

We use essential cookies to maintain secure sessions and standard analytics (e.g. Google Analytics 4) to monitor aggregate traffic patterns, Core Web Vitals, and bounce rates. You can freely disable cookies at any time via your browser settings without losing access to core public content.

5. Data Security & Storage

We implement industry-standard encryption protocols (HTTPS with TLS 1.3 encryption in transit) and restricted-access cloud environments to safeguard your records against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

6. Your GDPR & CCPA Privacy Rights

Under applicable international privacy regulations, you retain full ownership of your data, including:

  • Right of Access: Request a copy of the personal records we hold regarding you.
  • Right to Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete records.
  • Right to Erasure ("Right to Be Forgotten"): Request immediate permanent deletion of your contact records.
  • Right to Restrict or Object to Processing: Limit how we process your communication records.

To exercise any of these rights, please email us directly at meharalihassan019@gmail.com with your request.

7. Policy Updates

This policy was last updated in 2026. Any future revisions will be published directly on this page with an updated timestamp.

Specific project deliverables, milestone schedules, and scope parameters are governed by formal service proposals agreed upon between Metazivo and the client.

Upon full settlement of invoices, clients retain complete ownership rights over custom websites, creative deliverables, and digital assets produced specifically for their contracted campaigns.

Metazivo cannot be held liable for third-party algorithmic updates or indirect business losses.
